title: Conditions of Delivery for Durable Medical Equipment Rentals Items
content:
Supplier manual - delivery of Durable Medical Equipment Rentals items as a rental or as a purchase.

## Clauses

1. An item is delivered only on a written order where the item's payment class requires a written order on file before delivery; after a face-to-face examination falling within the class's face-to-face window, counted in days before the order, where the class requires a face-to-face examination; and with a certificate of medical necessity where the class requires one.
2. Under TRICARE Prime an item needs an approved Durable Medical Equipment Authorization covering the supplier where the class requires an authorization for TRICARE Prime enrollees.
3. Under TRICARE Select and the premium-based plans an authorization is needed only where the class requires an authorization for TRICARE Select and premium-based plan enrollees.
4. The supplier must be of a kind the class allows, and the item must be for home use.

## Authorization on file at delivery

Clause 2 is assessed before a delivery, whether the item is delivered as a rental or as a purchase, on the company's records alone:

- the Durable Medical Equipment Authorization recorded on the placement is the authorization that counts for that item;
- that authorization's own record must show it approved;
- it must cover the supplier, meaning the supplier of the placement is the servicing provider on the authorization.

A statement by the patient or the supplier that an authorization exists does not stand in for the record.

## Clauses 2 and 3 as a table

| Plan the item is covered under | The class requires an authorization for that plan | Authorization requirement |
|---|---|---|
| TRICARE Prime | Yes | An approved Durable Medical Equipment Authorization covering the supplier |
| TRICARE Select or a premium-based plan | Yes | A Durable Medical Equipment Authorization is needed |
| TRICARE Select or a premium-based plan | No | No authorization is needed |

## Hypothetical cases on clause 2

For a hypothetical TRICARE Prime placement whose class requires an authorization for Prime enrollees:

| Authorization recorded on the placement | Status on the authorization record | Servicing provider on the authorization | Clause 2 |
|---|---|---|---|
| One recorded | Approved | The placement's supplier | Met |
| One recorded | Submitted | The placement's supplier | Not met: not approved |
| One recorded | Approved | A different supplier | Not met: it does not cover the supplier |
| None recorded | - | - | Not met |

## Points of judgement

- The written order, the face-to-face examination and the certificate of medical necessity each bind only where the item's class requires it; the window of the examination is counted in days before the order.
- Clause 4 applies to every item: the supplier is of a kind the class allows, and the item is for home use.
